tasks.gr9-functions-relationships-t3: Topic: Functions and Relationships. Cover formalising relationships between variables, multiple representations (tables, formulae, graphs), and interpreting trends. Ask Grade 9 learners to connect different representations, identify input-output relationships, describe patterns meaningfully, match equations to tables and graphs, and explain how changes in one variable affect another.
tasks.gr9-graphs-t3: Topic: Graphs. Cover plotting points on the Cartesian plane, drawing linear and non-linear graphs, reading information from graphs, and interpreting slope and intercepts. Ask Grade 9 learners to plot accurately, identify x- and y-intercepts, describe graph shape and trend, link equations to their graphical form, and answer questions about values and relationships from graphs.
tasks.gr9-surface-volume-3d-t3: Topic: Surface Area and Volume of 3D Objects. Cover surface area and volume formulae for rectangular prisms, cylinders, and composite 3D shapes; nets of solids. Ask Grade 9 learners to calculate surface area and volume accurately, interpret 3D measurement answers in context, use correct units, distinguish surface area from volume, and apply formulae to practical problems.
tasks.gr9-factorising-algebraic-expressions-t3: Topic: Factorising algebraic expressions. Cover common factors (including a common bracket and opposite brackets), grouping four terms, the difference of two squares, trinomials x^2 + bx + c and a x^2 + bx + c with a common factor a, and simplifying algebraic fractions by cancelling factors. Ask Grade 9 learners to factorise completely and to check by expanding.
tasks.gr9-solving-equations-by-factorising-t3: Topic: Solving equations by factorising. Cover a product of factors equal to 0 (zero-product rule), common factor and difference of two squares equations, trinomial equations, setting up equations from rectangles, prisms and ages, rejecting impossible solutions, and substitution into expressions to build tables of ordered pairs. Ask Grade 9 learners to write each equation equal to 0 first and to check solutions by substituting.
